sanskrit_verse: विवादे सोत्तरपणे द्वयोर् यस् तत्र हीयते । स पणं स्वकृतं दाप्यो विनयं च पराजये ॥
transliteration: vivāde sottarapaṇe dvayor yas tatra hīyate | sa paṇaṃ svakṛtaṃ dāpyo vinayaṃ ca parājaye ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In a dispute involving a wager, he who suffers loss therein shall bear his own stake and yield discipline upon defeat.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from conscious engagement in contest
Causation is traced to individual capacity and risk assumption
Capacity-based responsibility demands ownership of outcome
Restoration logic aligns with completion of contractual integrity
Consciousness alignment occurs through acceptance of consequence
executable_legal_axioms: IF dispute involves mutual wager AND one party incurs loss THEN that party bears their own stake autonomously
IF defeat occurs THEN responsible party must demonstrate disciplinary realignment
IF contest lacks consent OR clarity THEN nullify wager before adjudication
IF participant withdraws prior to resolution THEN no liability attaches
supreme_court_application: This verse establishes threshold criteria for adjudicating disputes arising from voluntary contractual contests. The Supreme Court must ensure that liability is self-contained within the bounds of agreed engagement, affirming that consequences are inherently aligned with conscious participation rather than external imposition.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that the losing party entered knowingly into the agreement; anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential manifestation from choice to result; proportional responsibility lies solely within assumed risk; the non-punitive reality rule affirms restoration via completion, not infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Party acknowledges and executes transfer of owed stake without coercion
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Participant reaffirms understanding of terms and accepts outcome
Capacity Restoration: Disciplinary compliance restores eligibility for future engagements
Integrity Reintegration: Public record reflects fulfillment of obligation as consciousness affirmation
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored through conscious completion. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the supreme adjudicator.
